say: Choose one service you can sell, and get ready safely.
This is the video for module one of Freelancing Fundamentals.
A freelancer is a self-employed person who sells a service to several clients. You find the client, agree the job, do it, send the bill and make sure you are paid.

say: Every job passes through six stages: find, pitch, agree, deliver, get paid, and keep the client. Beginners often focus only on doing the work, and are surprised when the money does not come.

say: A billable hour is an hour of work a client pays for. Finding clients, pitching and invoicing are not billable.
For example, Amaka in Ibadan has two school-age children. Let us count her week.

panel.heading: How many of your hours can earn?
items: Add up every hour you can work in a week
Take out time for finding clients and admin
Take out time for revisions, calls and learning
What is left are your billable hours
Multiply by 4 for your month

say: She can work 5 hours a day on weekdays, plus 2 hours on Saturday. That is 27 working hours a week.

say: She keeps 1 hour each weekday for finding clients and admin. That is 5 hours.

say: So 27 minus 5 minus 4 leaves 18 billable hours a week.

say: Over about 4 weeks, that is 72 billable hours a month, not 108.
If you price as if every hour is paid, you will earn far less than you planned.

say: The most common beginner mistake is offering everything. Instead, list skills you have really used, written as tasks someone could pay for.

panel.heading: Find one service with real demand
items: List what you can already do, as tasks
Look for evidence that people pay for it
Score each skill 1 to 5 on skill and demand
Write your offer line

say: Next, look for evidence of demand: job sites, local businesses, people in your network, and your WhatsApp groups. Many sellers is a good sign. It proves people buy.

items: List what you can already do, as tasks

say: Then score each skill from 1 to 5 on skill and on demand. For example, Hauwa in Kaduna found translation scored 9 out of 10, so it became her first service.

say: Lines like I am a writer, or I do social media, leave the client guessing.
Compare this. I help small online fashion shops sell more by writing clear product descriptions. It names the client, the result and the service, without promising results you cannot control.
A buffer is savings that cover your essential costs while you build clients, so you do not accept bad jobs out of panic. A common rule of thumb is about three months of essentials.
Chioma's essential costs are about 200,000 naira a month. Three months would be 600,000.
But her shop job covers about 150,000 a month.
So her real gap is only 50,000 a month.
Her buffer is 50,000 times 3, which is 150,000 naira, not 600,000. She saves 25 percent of every freelance payment until it is complete.
Scammers follow people looking for work online. Learn three patterns.
One. Someone asks you to pay for training or a fee before you start. Real clients pay you.

cards.d: A client asks you to pay for training, software or registration first. Real clients pay you.
They send too much, beg you to refund the extra, then the first payment disappears.
Never share the six-digit code sent to your phone. It lets them take your WhatsApp or bank.

say: Two. Someone pays more than agreed, then begs you to refund the extra. The first payment later disappears, and your refund is gone.

cards.d: A client asks you to pay for training, software or registration first. Real clients pay you.
They send too much, beg you to refund the extra, then the first payment disappears.
Never share the six-digit code sent to your phone. It lets them take your WhatsApp or bank.

say: Three. Someone asks for the six-digit code sent to your phone. Never share it.
And screenshots are not payment. Start work only when the money shows in your own banking app.

say: Before you look for clients, run this check. A professional email, two-step verification, a WhatsApp Business profile, cloud storage and a calendar, a backup connection, and a safe payment channel.

panel.heading: Your readiness check
items: Professional email address
Two-step verification switched on
WhatsApp Business with your offer line
Cloud storage and a calendar
A backup connection
Safe, traceable payment channel

say: To remember. You run a one-person business. Plan income on billable hours. Choose one service with real demand.
Write an offer line that names the client, the result and the service. And never pay to work or share your codes.
